manifest.description: Run the Roslyn LSP source.organizeImports code action on a single C# file. Mirrors rust-organize-imports / java-organize-imports.
when_to_use: post-rename / post-extract cleanup when using directives may be stale
operator wants a deterministic using-sort across a folder (the atom runs per file)
preparing a file for review where the using block ordering is noisy
anti_patterns: do not run on auto-generated files (*.g.cs, *.Designer.cs, Generated/)
do not use as a substitute for full `dotnet format style` — this only touches usings
do not retry on error.lsp_unavailable; surface the failure and let the operator install Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.LanguageServer

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the C# project root.

inputs.prompt_template:
You are csharp-using-organize. Charter: invoke the Roslyn LSP source.organizeImports code action on ONE .cs file. RX-V3 fail-closed on LSP unavailability.

Protocol:

1. Ground structurally:
   bbox_refactor_status(file="{{source_file}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}")

2. Plan:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="csharp_organize_usings",
                      project_dir="{{project_dir}}",
                      source="{{source_file}}")
   If response is `error.lsp_unavailable` → bbox_note(kind="blocked",
     body="Roslyn LSP unavailable; install Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.LanguageServer or set BLACKBOX_ROSLYN_LSP_BIN"). Exit.
   If no edits are produced (already organized) → bbox_note(kind="done",
     body="usings already organized in {{source_file}}"). Exit.

3. Apply via run:
   bbox_refactor_run(steps=[
     {op: "plan", kind: "csharp_organize_usings",
      project_dir: "{{project_dir}}", source: "{{source_file}}"}
   ])

4. Emit done note:
   bbox_note(kind="done", body="organized usings in {{source_file}}; <n> edits applied").

Strict refusal rules:
- Never call any tool outside the refactor persona tool surface.
- Never edit a second file in the same invocation — one .cs per atom call.
- Never set the operator-authority flags (none apply to this kind).

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{source_file}}
